scope: unprivileged offline-build owner with elevated Docker client only
finding: A signaled sudo wrapper can complete the ordinary wait path with a negative code. The later nonzero raise bypasses client-retirement classification, so a surviving elevated Docker descendant can mutate the daemon after container cleanup while the lease is released.
required_correction: Classify abnormal privileged-client termination as retirement-unproven on every completion path, including an already-exited wrapper.
Conservatively retain the lease unless descendant retirement is independently proved; terminal container observation cannot clear client uncertainty.
Add a bounded regression for a killed sudo wrapper with a surviving client and delayed daemon mutation, plus already-exited negative classification.
accepted_controls: Real/effective root rejection and an unprivileged Python owner.
Fixed absolute sudo/Docker argv and request-independent executable selection.
Allowlisted environment plus non-serialized inherited SUDO_ASKPASS.
Unchanged direct/injected preparation transport, container UID/profile and single start-then-wait sequencing.
The fixed Unix socket plus actual immutable-image inspection sufficiently binds the trusted local daemon for this boundary.
limitations: No source-boundary or one-shot offline-build release is granted. No build, module, guest, runtime or OS acceptance follows.
